recordActions.saved: Saved. The change is on the list now.
recordActions.deleted: Deleted. It is no longer on the list.
recordActions.saveFailed: We could not save your change, so nothing was changed. Check your connection and try again.
recordActions.deleteFailed: We could not delete this, so nothing was removed. Check your connection and try again, or ask the farm owner.

workforce.shiftWhat: This shift from the schedule. The worker will no longer see it.
workforce.taskWhat: This task, with its notes and progress.

reportBuilder.templateWhat: This report template. Reports already made from it stay in your history.

supplyChain.traceEmpty: Nothing has been recorded for this batch yet. Log an event on the Events tab to start its trail.
supplyChain.traceFailed: We could not load the trail of this batch. Check your connection and try again, or ask the farm owner if you should see it.

lineage.inbreedingHint: A number from 0 to 1. Above 0.0625 is flagged as high.
lineage.treeEmpty: No parents are recorded for this animal yet. Add the sire and dam when you create its genetic profile.
lineage.treeFailed: We could not load the family tree. Check your connection and try again, or ask the animal's owner if you should see it.

digitalTwin.twinWhat: This digital twin and every simulation that was run on it.
digitalTwin.simWhat: This simulation and its results. You can run it again any time.

sustainability.currentValueHint: The progress bar is worked out from this number.
sustainability.metricWhat: This recorded entry. The totals and averages are worked out again without it.

geofence.zoneWhat: This zone. Past movement events stay in the history without it.

wellness.reminderWhat: This reminder. The animal and its health records are not affected.

chat.chatWhat: This chat and all its messages. Only you could see it.
chat.openFailed: We could not open that chat. It may have been deleted, or your connection dropped. Pick another chat or start a new one.

iot.sensorWhat: This sensor and all the readings it recorded.
